name: Milestone Timeline
summary: Dated events on a time axis with labels alternating above and below, collision-free leader lines, kind-based marker shapes and colours; switches to a vertical layout in narrow blocks.
summary_zh: 按时间轴排列的事件里程碑：标签上下交替并自动分层避免重叠，引线不交叉，按事件类型区分形状与颜色；窄版块自动切换为纵向布局。
description_zh: 展示公司重大事件（业绩发布、指引调整、并购、评级变化）或交易流程关键节点。数据为每行一个事件：日期（encode.date）、标题（encode.label）、类型（encode.kind，决定标记形状/颜色与图例）、说明（encode.detail，显示在提示框或纵向布局的正文中）。横向布局按真实时间比例定位，标签在轴上下交替，拥挤时自动分层且保证引线不穿过其他标签，底部为季度/年份刻度，可加“今天”虚线；版块较窄（< 560px）或 orientation 为 vertical 时改为“日期列 | 轴 | 标题+说明”的纵向列表，并以年份胶囊分隔。点击事件或图例按类型交叉筛选（例如让股价图只显示业绩类事件），筛选变化时标签平滑移动到新位置。也可配合 where 只显示交易时间表中的里程碑。
best_for: Share price event history next to a price chart
Key dates of a transaction process (milestones only)
avoid_when: More than ~20 events in one block (use a table or a Gantt)
Events that need a value axis (annotate a line chart instead)

kind.desc: Event type — marker shape / colour, legend and click-to-filter

detail.desc: Longer description: tooltip, and under the label in vertical layout

orientation.desc: auto (vertical when the block is narrower than 560px) | horizontal | vertical

side.desc: Horizontal label placement: both (alternate above / below) | above | below

labelStyle.desc: flag (text beside the leader, flips at the right edge) | center (text centred on the leader)

labelWidth.desc: Maximum label width in px (horizontal; narrowed automatically when lanes do not fit)

marker.desc: shape (shape per kind) | number (numbered discs in date order, for footnote references) | dot

kindColors.desc: {kind: colour token} e.g. {"m&a": "accent2", "guidance": "neg"}; tokens: accent, accent2, accent3, pos, neg, ink2, cat1..cat8 or an index

kindLabels.desc: {kind: display name} for the legend and tooltip (default: capitalised kind)

showDetail.desc: Show the detail text under each label: true | false | 'auto' (vertical layout, only when it fits the block height)

dateFormat.desc: Date format on the labels (tooltip uses the field format)

spacing.desc: Vertical layout: even (rows with year markers) | time (proportional, labels dodged with elbow leaders)

domain.desc: [start, end] fixed time window for the horizontal axis

today.desc: Dashed 'today' marker ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'now'); null hides it

todayLabel.desc: Label under the today marker (date is appended)

highlight.desc: Event label(s) to emphasise (bold title, accent-2 date, larger marker)

interactions: Hover an event for a tooltip with date, type and detail
Click an event or a legend entry to cross-filter by type (others dim)
Staggered reveal: axis draws, markers pop, leaders draw, labels rise
Labels glide to their new lanes when filters change; layout re-flows on resize
Keyboard: events are focusable, Enter toggles the filter
